arrival.description: A METAL CORE wearing a ~20-mile-deep global ocean, with exposed core-mountains breaching the waterline. They almost cleared the whole moon getting it here.
arrival.exposed_massifs: metallic luster — like gold or silver. The perfect lie made physical: everyone assumes a gold rush; the truth is POWER, not price.

departure.description: 246-mile moon: 159-mile heterogeneous exotic-mineral core wrapped in ~43 miles of ice.

disclaimer: Real Saturn. Fictional crime. All characters fictional; no real persons depicted.
framing: THE MIMAS INQUIRY: A Declassified History of the Saturn Heist
governing_truth: The core is a MINERAL OF POWER: not about price, not about gold — energy, the future, "the thing you need to accomplish everything about the unknown. Whoever holds the core holds the next century."

moon.name: Mimas
moon.note: "246 miles? That's nothing. We can move that."

tagline: They thought they were stealing a mineral. They were stealing a question.

voyage.diameter_change: loses diameter AND mass — ice stripped and burned as fusion fuel
voyage.mechanism: mass drivers throw Mimas's own ice overboard as reaction mass; the moon burns pieces of itself to travel
